title: Strings Ringing Out Between Chord Changes
summary: In this instructional piece by JustinGuitar, the host explains that open strings ringing between chord changes is a normal, often audible phenomenon in guitar playing. He notes that such strings frequently appear on the up-strum after beat four, especially at faster tempos, and may go unnoticed in real-time. The guidance emphasizes keeping the strum light on the thinner strings, slowing down to hear the effect, and maintaining a relaxed, tension-free approach to changes to preserve musical ease. The lesson also encourages listening with the ears, accepting that some “wrong” sounds can be aesthetically pleasing in creativity, and reassures learners not to be upset by occasional open-string noises during changes.
